sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER Heard and perused the case diary.

1. This is the SECOND bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.641/2023, registered at P.S.-Betma, District-Indore (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Section 376(2)(n), 506, 450,
509 of IPC and under Sections 37 of the IT Act.
He is in detention since 30.09.2023.

Earlier, first bail application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 01.11.2023, passed in MCRC No.46837/2023, with liberty to renew the prayer after three months or after record of statements of the prosecutrix and her parents.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this crime.
The period of liberty so granted by this Court has already been lapsed, but the statements of the prosecutrix and her parents have not been recorded till date.
Earlier, it was directed to renew the prayer either after three months or after recording of statements of the prosecutrix and her parents.

The direction for recording of statements of prosecutrix was given in appearance of prosecutrix's counsel even then the prosecutrix and witnesses are not turning up for recording of their statements, hence, no one can be kept in jail for indefinite period.
Investigation is over and charge-sheet has been filed.
The applicant is in custody since 30.09.2023.
Final conclusion of the trial is likely to take sufficient long time, therefore, it is prayed that the application be allowed and the applicant be released on bail.
3. Learned counsel for the State opposes the application and prays for its dismissal.
4. Counsel for the objector has opposed the prayer vehemently by submitting that the allegations against the applicant is of making obscene video of prosecutrix, hence, bail should be rejected.
However, he has admitted that the prosecutrix is a major lady and the period of liberty so granted has already been lapsed and the witnesses have not turned up for recording of their statements.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties and custody period of the applicant and specifically looking to the fact that even after direction of this court, the prosecutrix did not appear before the trial Court for recording of her statement, but without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is allowed.
6.

It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with on solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction o f the trial Court, to appear before the trial Court on the dates given by the Court.

The applicant shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(PREM NARAYAN SINGH) JUDGE amit Govind @ Kanha Hanuman vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189320235/
